title: Gas alarm
body_md: If a connected gas warning device reports a gas alarm through the connected alarm system, Pro-finder sends a corresponding message. Here too it additionally calls the master number afterwards.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Gas alarm” with red addition
prev_context: Before this stands the intrusion report.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 20: equivalent in substance. Neither version says what happens if the callback is not answered – with a gas alarm this remains a safety-relevant gap.
